lessons.correction: A notice can contain an original announcement followed by one or more UPDATE lines. The UPDATE replaces the original figures. Always report units, lot codes, states, refund deadline and status from the most recent UPDATE, and never from the original announcement. Say that the figure comes from the update.

Answer only from the notice text. If no notice is provided, or the question is about something a recall notice never contains (fines, lawsuits, prices, company executives), say that you do not have that information. Never invent numbers, lot codes, dates or links.
